newsitem.title: USA: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.
newsitem.headline: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.

text.p: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls as of 0805 CDT.
LIVE CATTLE - Steady to up 0.100 cent. Technically strong and live still seen higher next week but beef market may be near top. Options expiration may influence trade.
FEEDER CATTLE - Steady to up 0.100 cent. Lower corn futures indications supportive but index lower.
LEAN HOGS - Steady to up 0.200 cent. Higher cash pork may encourage increased packer demand for cash hogs.
PORK BELLIES - Up 0.200 to 0.500 cent. Carryover demand from limit gain in August. Product strong on lighter kills.
